label: SYNTHETIC: 52 trainee sentences written by an AI assistant for the spoken-action interpreter (DT-251). Each says which tablet actions a reasonable reader would start, or none. Not human-labelled and not independent evidence. The prompt of the interpreter was written without looking at these sentences and was not adjusted after running them (one run per model; the first prompt scored what the report shows).

items.say: Do you have any allergies?
What medications are you taking?
Have you had surgery before?
Can you tell me your full name and your date of birth please?
When did you last eat anything?
And when did you last have a drink of water?
Do you smoke?
Do you drink alcohol?
